text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275)
Notice under Sections 10 (6) and 17 (6) for the Issue of Revised Loose-leaf Pages of Subsidiary Legislation
Issue 1/2001
Whereas pursuant to sections 10(6) and 17(6) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have prepared and published the loose-leaf pages set out in the Schedule incorporating all amendments up to 30th June 2001 made to the Rules of Court (Chapter 322, R 5):
Now, therefore, it is hereby notified for general information that the Commissioners have appointed 31st July 2001 as the date the revised loose-leaf pages of the Rules of Court in this Issue shall come into force.
